# T-2: Wire pass history retrieval in shared gate flow

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Retrieve previously-passed guardrail IDs from the issue-log in runGateFlow and pass them through to the prompt builder for all retry-tracked phases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- runGateFlow retrieves pass history from issue-log via findPreviousPassedGuardrails
- Pass history is forwarded to checkGuardrail regardless of content change status
- All retry-tracked phases (draft, spec, task-impl, integration) receive pass history

## Implementation Notes
In runGateFlow, call findPreviousPassedGuardrails to get the previous pass list. Pass it to checkGuardrail. The existing applyFlipOverride remains as a post-evaluation fallback.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests verifying that runGateFlow passes previouslyPassed to checkGuardrail when issue-log has pass history. Verify no pass history is passed on first evaluation.
